notes: City Clerk Tag Sale Permits page quoting Ordinance Chapter 351: a City Clerk permit is required for any tag, garage, lawn, cellar, attic or rummage sale (351-1); up to 3 consecutive days (351-3); apply at least 48 hours ahead (351-4); no more than 4 sales a calendar year at one location (351-6); fee $10 for the 1st and 2nd permit, $20 for the 3rd and 4th (351-8). The ecode360 copy of Chapter 351 shows an older flat $10 fee and a 2-occasion rule in 351-5; the city page (updated 2023-03-20) is used. The live site says no permit is needed, which is wrong. Live site permit link is broken: +garage+sale+permit']
